target_buyer_1.organization: Ohio SBDC at Terra State Community College
target_buyer_1.location: Terra State Community College, Fremont, OH
target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: On campus since 1988 providing confidential one-to-one advising and entrepreneurial training programs. Serves Erie, Ottawa, Sandusky and Seneca Counties. Mission: 'Accelerate Ohio's economy by helping people start, sustain and grow their businesses!' Services are free of charge. Offers Small Business Basics training with downloadable resources including business plan worksheets, pro forma templates, and Ohio startup guides. Engages in outreach linking federal, state, local government resources with educational and private sector. Modular learning platform would enhance their training delivery and extend reach beyond workshop schedules.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Ashtabula County organization of local business owners networking to promote business and exchange client contacts. Mission: 'To exchange and promote business with members and support member businesses through information sharing and education, encouraging and sustaining entrepreneurship in Ashtabula County.' Offers Jay Sartini Memorial Scholarship for graduating high school seniors and Kent State students. Weekly meetings (Thursdays 7:15am) with Business Boost presentations. Promotes secondary business education through scholarships, mentorship, and information sharing. Exclusivity policy (one business per category). Learning modules would support their education mission and member development.

acbe.name: Ashtabula County Business Exchange (AcBE)
acbe.mission: To exchange and promote business with members and support member businesses through information sharing. To support secondary business education in Ashtabula County encouraging and sustaining entrepreneurship.

meeting_schedule.cancellation_policy: If Ashtabula City Schools or A-Tech is closed or delayed, meeting is cancelled

programs: Jay Sartini Memorial Scholarship for graduating high school seniors and second-year Kent State students

membership_policy.exclusivity: Only one business per business category

acbe.testimonial: AcBE provides the opportunity for members to get to know each other both personally and professionally. It provides a great network of resources for each member to refer clients and contacts to with confidence. AcBE is so much more than a networking group, we are like a family. - Debbie Powell of Berkshire Hathaway Home Services Professional Realty
